name: literal-c-build-edits
build_ninja:
rule cc
  command = cc -O2 -g0 -frandom-seed=0 -fdiagnostics-color=never -I../source/early -I../source/late -I../source -I. -MD -MF $out.d -o $out -c $in
  depfile = $out.d
  deps = gcc
rule link
  command = cc -frandom-seed=0 $in -o $out
build main.o: cc ../source/main.c
build lib.o: cc ../source/lib.c
build app: link main.o lib.o

edits.name: include-order-change
edits.build_ninja:
rule cc
  command = cc -O2 -g0 -frandom-seed=0 -fdiagnostics-color=never -I../source/late -I../source/early -I../source -I. -MD -MF $out.d -o $out -c $in
  depfile = $out.d
  deps = gcc
rule link
  command = cc -frandom-seed=0 $in -o $out
build main.o: cc ../source/main.c
build lib.o: cc ../source/lib.c
build app: link main.o lib.o

edits.name: generated-header
edits.build_ninja:
rule cc
  command = cc -O2 -g0 -frandom-seed=0 -fdiagnostics-color=never -I../source/late -I../source/early -I../source -I. -MD -MF $out.d -o $out -c $in
  depfile = $out.d
  deps = gcc
rule link
  command = cc -frandom-seed=0 $in -o $out
rule generate
  command = printf '#define GENERATED 4\n' > $out
build generated.h: generate
build main.o: cc ../source/main.c
build lib.o: cc ../source/lib.c || generated.h
build app: link main.o lib.o
